subject: general
question: Which state hosted the Khelo India Youth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **5th edition** of the **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2022** was officially hosted by the state of **Madhya Pradesh**. Although the event was titled "2022," it took place from **January 30 to February 11, 2023**, due to scheduling adjustments.
 
• The games were held across **eight different cities** in **Madhya Pradesh**, including **Bhopal**, **Indore**, **Gwalior**, **Ujjain**, **Maheshwar**, **Jabalpur**, **Mandla**, and **Balaghat**. A single event, **Cycling**, was organized in **New Delhi**.
 
• The **mascot** for the 2022 edition was **'Asha'** (a female **Cheetah**) and **'Mowgli'**. The smart torch of the games was named **'Amarkantak'**, featuring the figure of **Narmada**.
 
• The theme song for the games was **"Hindustan Ka Dil Dhadka Do,"** sung by the famous singer **Shaan**.
 
• **Maharashtra** emerged as the overall champion of the Khelo
